question: From what extent and within what time is the desired one certainly attracted?
premises: The desired one can be attracted from a distance of three thousand.
The attraction can be accomplished within three days.
The result of this attraction is declared certain.
inference: Therefore the desired one is certainly attracted from three thousand within three days.
uncertainties: The unit or measure implied by tri+sahasram is not explicitly specified.
plain_english: And one should certainly attract the desired one from three thousand away within three days.
